items.title: After a historic 53-day strike, Teleperformance union in Chile wins better working conditions
items.summary: The Teleperformance Chile Telematic Interpreters’ Union (SITTP) signed an agreement with the multinational Teleperformance (TP) on 25 September 2026, after a 53-day strike during its first collective bargaining process. SITTP was founded by TP interpreters who organized while working remotely from their homes in Chile. items.title: Casino workers in Massachusetts win better deal after 2-month strike
items.summary: Some 1,300 casino workers at Wynn Resort’s Encore Boston Harbor in the United States have secured a new 5-and-a-half-year contract ending a 63-day strike. The new deal was ratified by members of UNI Global Union affiliate UNITE HERE Local 26 and Teamsters Local 25 on 5 November. items.title: Irish unions honoured for organizing tech workers
